newsHighlights.title: Imports poised to hit record high
newsHighlights.summary: China's imports are on track to reach a record high this year, driven by strong domestic demand and expanding global trade ties.
newsHighlights.translation: 受强劲内需与不断拓展的全球贸易关系推动，中国今年进口额有望创下历史新高。

newsHighlights.title: Chinese county plucks strings of global violin market
newsHighlights.summary: A small Chinese county has captured a dominant share of the global violin market by combining craftsmanship with modern industrial scale.
newsHighlights.translation: 一个中国小县城将传统工艺与现代产业规模相结合，在全球小提琴市场占据了主导份额。

newsHighlights.title: Six major contributors call for EU budget cut
newsHighlights.summary: Six of the largest net contributors to the EU have urged Brussels to trim the bloc's next long-term budget, citing fiscal discipline.
newsHighlights.translation: 欧盟六个最大净出资国呼吁布鲁塞尔削减下一个长期预算，理由是需要维持财政纪律。

newsHighlights.title: US-Canada trade war escalates as both sides remain open to a new deal
newsHighlights.summary: Trade tensions between the United States and Canada have intensified, though both governments say they are still willing to negotiate a new agreement.
newsHighlights.translation: 美加贸易摩擦升级，但两国政府均表示仍愿意就新协议展开谈判。

newsHighlights.title: AI focus shifts to application and regulation
newsHighlights.summary: Global attention on artificial intelligence is moving from model competition toward real-world applications and regulatory frameworks.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球对人工智能的关注正从模型竞赛转向实际应用与监管框架。

quote.quote: The best investment you can make is in yourself.
quote.author: Warren Buffett
quote.translation: 你能做的最好投资，就是投资你自己。
quote.explanation: 在商业与金融领域，真正的长期回报来自于持续学习与自我提升，而非追逐短期行情。

pattern.pattern: be poised to do sth.（有望做某事；准备就绪去做某事）
pattern.example: China's imports are poised to hit a record high this year.
pattern.translation: 中国的进口额有望在今年创下历史新高。
pattern.usage: 用于描述某事即将发生或已经做好准备，常见于财经报道预测趋势。也可写作 be poised for sth.，如 The market is poised for recovery.

grammar.title: 现在进行时表将来（Present Continuous for Future Arrangements）
grammar.explanation: 当事件已经安排好、即将发生时，常用现在进行时表达将来意义，常与表示未来的具体时间状语连用。这在财经新闻中非常常见，用来报道已确定的计划、会议或趋势。
examples: Trade tensions between the US and Canada are intensifying as both sides prepare for a new round of talks.
The autumn grain harvest is underway and the full-year crop is on track for another bumper harvest.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第四个音节 -a-tion 上，注意中间的 /ɡoʊʃ/ 发音类似“够什”。常见错误是把重音放在第二个音节。可拆分为 ni-GO-shee-AY-shun 慢读练习。
examples: The negotiation between the two countries lasted for several weeks.
Both sides said the negotiation was constructive.

reading.title: Global Trade at a Crossroads: Records, Rivalries and Regulations
reading.content: As the fourth quarter begins, global trade finds itself at an unusual crossroads. On one hand, China's imports are poised to hit a record high this year, powered by resilient domestic demand. Its exports tell an equally striking story: one small county now supplies a major share of the world's violins, proof that specialized manufacturing can conquer global niche markets. On the other hand, tensions are rising elsewhere. The trade war between the United States and Canada has escalated, even as both governments remain open to a new deal. In Europe, six major contributors are pressing for a tighter EU budget, demanding fiscal discipline from Brussels. Meanwhile, attention around artificial intelligence is shifting from flashy model launches toward practical applications and thoughtful regulation. Together, these signals suggest that the winners of tomorrow's economy will be those who balance ambition with discipline, and innovation with rules.
reading.translation: 随着第四季度开启，全球贸易正处在一个不寻常的十字路口。一方面，受强劲内需推动，中国今年的进口额有望创下历史新高。出口方面同样令人瞩目：一个中国小县城如今供应着全球小提琴市场的一大份额，证明专业化制造能够征服全球细分市场。另一方面，其他地区紧张局势正在升级。美加贸易战愈演愈烈，尽管两国政府仍对新协议持开放态度。在欧洲，六个主要出资国正敦促收紧欧盟预算，要求布鲁塞尔保持财政纪律。与此同时，围绕人工智能的关注正从炫目的模型发布转向实际应用与审慎监管。这些信号共同表明：明日经济的赢家，将是那些在雄心与纪律、创新与规则之间取得平衡的人。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily 与 CGTN 2026年10月1日相关新闻改写，包括 Imports poised to hit record high、Chinese county plucks strings of global violin market、Six major contributors call for EU budget cut、US-Canada trade war escalates 及 AI focus shifts to application and regulation。
